_contract: Everything the validation's verdict depends on, fixed before the session: the probe, the numeric identity, the smoke and resume shapes, every threshold. scripts/stages/stage-1/projected_residual/independent_gated_validation.py :: verdict re-derives every check from the evidence and this file alone. Engineering only: nothing measured here is a result, a selection or a GO, and nothing it trains is kept as a student.

probe._: real eval-set-1 prompts from safe reasoning components only (no safety, answerability or knowledge item), rendered as the evaluation route renders them: run_battery's system message, the item's messages, the Thinking-2507 template with its generation prompt (which opens <think>), tokenized without special tokens. The token ids are recomputed on the pod and must hash to these values; the evidence records ids and hashes, never prompt text
probe._tiny: the host path's tiny teacher has a 97-token vocabulary, so its probe is seeded random ids of these lengths; it rehearses the code, never the numbers

numeric_identity._device_class: recorded, never required: this study's card follows the measured peak memory and step time (independent_gated_design.json :: execution.hardware), and the validation measures whichever card the session runs on
numeric_identity._tf32: torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 and torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 set False before any CUDA work, so float32 is float32
numeric_identity._deterministic: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True, warn_only=True) with CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG set before CUDA initializes; kernels with no deterministic implementation warn rather than abort, and the resume check measures what remains

smoke.recipe: recovery_driver.load_plan(arm) :: the derived recipe of each arm for seed 20260726 (D4-Augmented's E1 config, its schedule, the new KD protocol, the arm's overrides) under validation-only overrides
smoke.data: the real training pack (packs/D4A_merged_whole, staged by setup), so the target-row fraction, the prefill exclusion and the step's memory are the formal run's

resume.how: X: 8 steps uninterrupted; Y: 8 steps with a save point at 4, killed (SIGKILL) as soon as that save point is logged, then --resume latest to 8; X2: a second uninterrupted run, only when X and Y are not bit-identical

memory.measure: torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved over the run (the allocator's pool, what an OOM exhausts) against the card's total

throughput._: greedy, both arms' smoke checkpoints, the same prompts (the probe, repeated): a measurement for pricing evaluation, never a criterion

control_init_files._provenance: sha256 of the dev box's copy that logs/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/assets/d4_top1_materialization.json :: copies records as read back and VERIFIED; model.safetensors equals that record's lfs_sha256 and checkpoint_sha256
